comment: Solar wind speeds are expected to become enhanced during the first period due to a northerly located coronal hole. There were two filament eruptions on the 13th and 14th resulting in CMEs that may glance the Earth late in the first period and into the second. This is likely to result in some ACTIVE geomagnetic activity with STORM G1 conditions possible especially with combined CME and and coronal hole effects.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
